description: This file defines the setup wizard for the Signal channel within the openclaw plugin SDK. It includes functions for detecting, installing, and configuring 'signal-cli', as well as managing credentials and user interface prompts.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizard
classes.description: Object implementing the setup wizard interface for the Signal communication channel.

methods.name: detectBinary
methods.description: Detects the presence of the signal-cli binary at the specified path.

methods.name: setSetupChannelEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables setup options for a specified channel in the configuration.

methods.name: listSignalAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all configured Signal account IDs in the current configuration.

methods.name: resolveSignalAccount
methods.description: Resolves a Signal account's configuration details given an account ID.

methods.name: installSignalCli
methods.description: Performs the installation of the signal-cli binary.

methods.name: createSignalCliPathTextInput
methods.description: Creates a text input UI element for specifying the path to signal-cli.

methods.name: normalizeSignalAccountInput
methods.description: Normalizes the user input for Signal account configuration.

methods.name: parseSignalAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Parses user entries to determine allowed sources for Signal messages.

methods.name: signalCompletionNote
methods.description: Text note shown upon completion of Signal setup.

methods.name: signalDmPolicy
methods.description: Defines the direct message handling policy for Signal.

methods.name: signalNumberTextInput
methods.description: Creates a text input UI element for Signal numbers.

methods.name: signalSetupAdapter
methods.description: Adapter object for Signal setup configuration.
